mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.project_id SET r.freelancer_exited = CASE WHEN r.freelancer_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE r.freelancer_exited END, r.client_exited = CASE WHEN p.client_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE r.client_exited END WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (room_id, sender_id, content, created_at, is_read) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{exitMessage}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id, r.project_id, p.title, u.user_id AS opponent_id, u.name, u.profile_image_url FROM chat_rooms r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.project_id JOIN users u ON (CASE WHEN r.freelancer_id = #{loginUserId} THEN p.client_id ELSE r.freelancer_id END) = u.user_id WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT room_id FROM chat_rooms WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR opponent_id = #{userId}) LIMIT 1
